<!-- This reset closes every editor tab outside group 1, including documents.
     Keep the preview in group 1. Panel terminals, including Quarto, are preserved. -->
[reset-side-terminal-editors]: command:runCommands {data-args='[{"commands":["workbench.action.focusFirstEditorGroup","workbench.action.closeEditorsInOtherGroups",{"command":"vscode.setEditorLayout","args":{"groups":[{}]}}]}]'}

[Close terminals][reset-side-terminal-editors]{#terminal-toggle-close-action hidden="hidden"}

```{=html}
<script>
(() => {
  const initialize = () => {
    const buttons = [...document.querySelectorAll("button[data-terminal-toggle]")];
    const closeAction = document.getElementById("terminal-toggle-close-action");

    const setOpened = (button, opened) => {
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(opened));
      const label = button.dataset.terminalLabel || "terminals";
      button.textContent = `${opened ? "Close" : "Open"} ${label}`;
    };
    const resetButtons = () => buttons.forEach(button => setOpened(button, false));

    for (const button of buttons) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const opened = button.getAttribute("aria-pressed") === "true";
        const action = opened ? closeAction
          : button.closest(".terminal-toggle").querySelector(".terminal-open-action");
        if (!action) return;

        // Native command links still execute through Quarto's command bridge.
        // There is no completion callback; labels reflect requested actions.
        action.click();
        resetButtons();
        if (!opened) setOpened(button, true);
      });
    }

    for (const button of document.querySelectorAll("button[data-terminal-reset]")) {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        if (!closeAction) return;
        closeAction.click();
        resetButtons();
      });
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initialize, { once: true });
  } else {
    initialize();
  }
})();
</script>
```
